catalog.method: GET fixed URL; one-line Base64 -> Argon2id + AES-256-GCM envelope (password P17, fallback P32) -> JSON; every text field value is then decrypted with mode 0 (GCM) on servers/top-level and mode 1 (CBC) on tweaks (decrypt_catalog_fields)
catalog.notes: 26 servers, 394 tweaks; catalog 3.4.9 live 2026-11-25. v1 files (.ar 1.0, XXTEA) are NOT opened by arpro.py: the engine falls back to the frozen C0 AR_PRO_VPN_archivos.py engine for them. No .sks support (excluded).

dependencies: Python >=3.10; standard library only (pure-Python AES included in the scripts)

files.method: Base64(IV + AES-256-CBC('AR PRO VPN' + profile JSON, key32)); key32 from the app password (decode_ar in arpro.py)
files.notes: Profile JSON has 28 fields; protections (password, root block, DeviceID, expiry, Play installer) checked after decryption. No real .ar 2.0 sample yet (synthetic round-trip only). No .sks support (excluded).

name: AR PRO VPN
